defs.def: to let sb/sth do sth; to let sth happen or be done 允许；准许

ex.s: But elevation is necessarily relative: only the choice of a reference point allows us to express numerically the height of an object or a location.
ex.t: 但海拔高度必然是相对的：只有选择一个参照点，我们才能用数值表示物体或地点的高度。

ex.s: This allows the Salk team to determine what genes are most beneficial to their plant designs.
ex.t: 这使 Salk 团队能够确定哪些基因对他们的植物设计最有益。

ex.s: Allowing kids to eat what they want also exposes them to the natural consequences of their decisions.
ex.t: 允许孩子吃他们想吃的东西，也会让他们尝到自己所作决定带来的自然结果。

ex.s: Allowing kids to eat cookies occasionally.
ex.t: 将宇宙模拟变成现实。

ex.s: Allow them to lead discussions and meetings to develop their communication skills.
ex.t: 让他们主导讨论和会议，以培养他们的沟通技能。

ex.s: The train’s equipment allows for basic checkups.
ex.t: 列车上的设备可以进行基本检查。

ex.s: The Language Exchange Programme allows students in pairs to communicate in two different languages they wish to share and learn each week.
ex.t: 语言交换项目让学生两人一组，每周用两种他们希望分享和学习的不同语言进行交流。

ex.s: These abilities are strengthened by our capacity for language, which allows social practices to develop in extremely unobvious ways.
ex.t: 这些能力因我们的语言能力而加强，语言能力让社会实践能以极其不明显的方式发展。

ex.s: Stay for as little or as long as your plans allow.
ex.t: 根据你的计划，想待多久就待多久。

ex.s: Today, there are about 2,000 or more grizzly bears in the US Their recovery has been so successful that the US Fish and Wildlife Service has twice attempted to delist grizzlies, which would loosen legal protections and allow them to be hunted.
ex.t: 如今，美国大约有2000只或更多的灰熊。它们的恢复如此成功，以至于美国鱼类和野生动物管理局曾两次试图将灰熊从保护名录中移除，这将放松法律保护并允许捕猎它们。

ex.s: Which working arrangement is allowed for a domestic student?
ex.t: 以下哪种工作安排是允许国内学生选择的？

ex.s: When I applied to graduate school, I found three programmes promising to allow me to follow my desired research direction.
ex.t: 当我申请研究生院时，我发现有三个项目承诺允许我按照自己期望的研究方向发展。

ex.s: ●Children are not allowed unaccompanied in all areas of the Museum.
ex.t: ●儿童不得在博物馆的所有区域无人陪同。

ex.s: The technology could determine whether a driver had just texted, emailed or done anything else that is not allowed under New York's hands-free driving laws.
ex.t: 该技术能判断司机是否刚刚发过短信、邮件或做了纽约免提驾驶法所不允许的其他事情。

ex.s: This allows it to take in air at 30 times the speed of a human sneeze, enabling it to drink 3L of water a second.
ex.t: 这使得它以人类喷嚏速度的30倍的速度在空气中摄取，使其能一秒饮用3L的水。

ex.s: It is different from traditional tourism because it allows the traveler to become 61 (educate) about the areas - both in terms of geographical conditions and cultural characteristics, and often provides money for conservation and benefits the 62 (develop) of the local areas.
ex.t: 它不同于传统旅游，因为它让旅行者受到____61（educate）关于该地区——无论是地理条件还是文化特征，并且常常为保护提供资金，造福当地的____62（develop）。

ex.s: Then, on two separate morning visits to the scientists’ lab, each man walked for an hour at an average speed that, in theory should allow his body to rely mainly on fat for fuel.
ex.t: 随后，在两次分别前往科学家实验室的早晨探访中，每名男子都以平均速度走了一小时，这个速度理论上应能让身体主要依靠脂肪供能。

ex.s: He   25   the police department to allow him to   26   a couple of “chat benches” in two of their local parks, Then he hung a colorful sign on each of the benches that   27   ：“HAPPY TO CHAT”.
ex.t: 他___25___警察局允许他在当地两个公园里___26___几条“聊天长椅”，然后在每条长椅上挂了一块彩色牌子，上面___27___：“乐意聊天”。

ex.s: Restaurants can offer a choice of music along with the various food choices on the menu, allowing customers more control over the atmosphere in which they are dining.
ex.t: 餐厅可以在菜单上各种食物选择之外提供音乐选择，让顾客更多地掌控用餐氛围。

ex.s: It allows one to work in the natural environment.
ex.t: 允许在自然环境中工作。

ex.s: A lunchtime escape allows her to keep a boss from tapping her on the shoulder.
ex.t: 午间逃离让她得以避免老板拍她肩膀。

ex.s: To allow students to experience zero gravity.
ex.t: 将太空技术与学校教育联系起来

ex.s: It would allow much room for free thinking．
ex.t: B．它将为自由思考提供很大空间

ex.s: He was just saying: “I’m king of this forest, and here is your reminder!” Once his message was delivered, he allowed me    70    (stay) and watch.
ex.t: 它只是在说："我是这片森林之王，这是提醒你！"一旦传达完信息，它允许我____70____（stay）留下观察。

ex.s: Among the bag makers' argument: many cities with bans still allow shoppers to purchase paper bags, which are easily recycled but require more energy to produce and transport.
ex.t: 在塑料袋生产商的说法中还提到：许多实施禁令的城市仍允许购物者购买纸袋，纸袋易于回收，但生产和运输耗能更多。

ex.s: After encapsulating the root ball in wire mesh, the movers allowed the tree to acclimate to its new situation for seven months before relocating it.
ex.t: 在把根球包裹在金属网中之后，搬迁人员在重新安置它之前，让树有七个月的时间来适应新环境。

ex.s: The articles in magazines are generally short, which allows a child to finish reading a feature article without losing interest due to short attention span.
ex.t: 杂志上的文章一般都很短，这使得儿童可以完成一篇专题文章的阅读，而不会因为关注时间短而失去兴趣。

ex.s: Federica Bertocchini, co-author of the study, says the worms’ ability to break down their everyday food — beeswax — also allows them to break down plastic.
ex.t: 该研究的合著者费德里卡·贝尔托基尼说，虫子分解日常食物——蜂蜡——的能力，也让它们能够分解塑料。

ex.s: What are the students allowed to wear in the lab ?
ex.t: 允许学生在实验室穿什么衣服？

ex.s: But during the past decade declining rainfall has allowed him to plant highly profitable crops.
ex.t: 但在过去十年里，降雨量的减少使他能够种植高利润的作物。

ex.s: exemptions are allowed
ex.t: 为了介绍豁免的概念。

ex.s: Some researchers argue that we can seal the machines inside a kind of firewall, using them to answer difficult questions but never allowing them to affect the real world.
ex.t: 一些研究者认为，我们可以把机器封在一种防火墙内，用它们来回答难题，但绝不允许它们影响真实世界。

ex.s: When lab rats are not allowed to sleep, they die within a month.
ex.t: 实验室里的老鼠如果不让睡觉，会在一个月内死亡。

ex.s: It allows me to “speak” with my hands.
ex.t: 它允许我用双手“说话”。

ex.s: “Doctors practice medicine and lawyers practice law and you should allow yourself the practice it takes to sustain a plant.
ex.t: “医生从事医学工作，律师从事法律工作，您应该允许自己进行维持植物所需的实践。

ex.s: From which date were private cars allowed to go out of Wuhan?
ex.t: 从哪一天起私家车被允许离开武汉？

ex.s: Freedom Day is held every year on 27 April to celebrate South Africa’s first fully-participated elections in 1994, in which everyone was allowed to vote regardless of skin colour.
ex.t: 每年4月27日是自由日，庆祝南非1994年首次全民参与的选举，在这次选举中，无论肤色如何，每个人都被允许投票。

defs.def: to let sb have sth 给予

ex.s: And above all, stories have a transformative power to allow us to see the world in a different way than we do if we just encounter it on our own.
ex.t: 而最重要的是，故事具有一种变革性的力量，能让我们以不同于独自面对世界时所采用的方式去看待世界。

defs.def: to let sb/sth go into, through, out of, etc. a place 允许进入（或出去、通过）

ex.s: By allowing us to understand the world the way they see it.
ex.t: 通过让我们以它们看世界的方式去理解世界。

ex.s: TransForm allows you to get to focus on your chosen track through subject matter talks, hands-on workshops, and off-site experiences.
ex.t: TransForm允许您通过主题演讲，实践讲习班，以及场外体验，专注于您选择的轨道。

ex.s: And because these spaces are filled with solid ice, liquid water cannot readily get inside, but it can when the permafrost melts, allowing more water to get through.
ex.t: 由于这些空间充满了坚实的冰，液态水不容易进入其中，但当永久冻土融化时就可以，从而让更多的水渗透过去。

ex.s: Writing was so difficult and painful for me that my teacher had allowed me to present my paper on the sinking of the Titanic by acting out a play, where I played all the parts.
ex.t: 写作对我来说太困难、太痛苦，以至于老师允许我通过表演一出戏来呈现关于泰坦尼克号沉没的论文，在戏里我扮演了所有角色。

ex.s: Writing was so difficult and painful for me that my teacher had allowed me to present my paper on the sinking of the Titanic by acting out a play, where I played all the parts.
ex.t: 写作对我来说太困难、太痛苦，以至于老师允许我通过表演一出戏来呈现关于泰坦尼克号沉没的论文，在戏里我扮演了所有角色。

ex.s: By underinflating the front bags, the team allowed the platform carrying the tree to roll up the ramp and out of the hole while staying level, A trailer hauled the tree along as team members removed the airbags from the back of the platform and replaced them in the front.
ex.t: 通过给前袋少充气，团队让载树的平台在保持水平的情况下滚上坡道出坑，拖车拖着树前行，成员们从平台后方取下气囊补到前方。

ex.s: The walls of the houses have a lot of holes in them to allow wind to pass through.
ex.t: 房屋的墙壁上有很多洞，可以让风通过。

defs.def: to make sth possible 使可能

ex.s: This capability allows for timely restoration.
ex.t: 这一能力使及时修复成为可能。

ex.s: I joined a pre-presentation dinner with him and that smaller setting allowed me to slowly build up my courage to speak one-on-one with him—an idea that had seemed completely impossible.
ex.t: 我和他一起参加了一个讲座前的晚餐，那种较小的环境让我慢慢积蓄勇气与他一对一交谈——这曾经看似完全不可能。

ex.s: The right level of background noise may interrupt our normal patterns of thinking just enough to allow our imaginations to wander, without making it impossible to focus.
ex.t: 恰到好处的背景噪音可能恰好会打断我们正常的思维模式，让我们的想象力得以漫游，而不会让人无法集中注意力。

defs.def: to make sure that you have enough of sth for a particular purpose （为某目的）留出，给出

ex.s: Alvaro Luna, a professor of electrical engineering, said that the system is innovative in so far as it allows for recycled energy to be redirected to specific local uses — in this case powering electric cars parked nearby.
ex.t: 电气工程教授Alvaro Luna表示，该系统的创新之处在于它能让回收的能量转向特定的本地用途——在这里就是为停在附近的电动汽车供电。

ex.s: The key finding of the study was that when crowds were further divided into smaller groups that were allowed to have a discussion, the averages from these groups were more accurate than those from an equal number of independent individuals.
ex.t: 这项研究的关键发现是，当人群被进一步分成可以进行讨论的小组时，这些小组的平均值比同等数量的独立个体的平均值更准确。

ex.s: Future 3D food printers could make processed food healthier． Hod Lipson， a professor at Columbia University， said， "Food printing could allow consumer to print food with customized nutritional content， like vitamins． So instead of eating a piece of yesterday 's bread from the supermarket， you'd eat something baked just for you on demand．"
ex.t: 未来的3D食品打印机可以让加工食品更健康。哥伦比亚大学教授霍德·利普森说：“食品打印可以让消费者打印出具有定制营养含量的食物，比如维生素。所以，你不必吃超市里昨天烤的面包，而是可以随时吃到专门为你现烤的食物。”

ex.s: 55  , after a brief stay in hospital, Ben was well enough to be allowed to   56   and later the family met up for dinner.
ex.t: 55  ，在医院短暂停留后，本康复到可以___56___，后来全家聚在一起吃晚饭。

ex.s: With good eating habits, you will be able to get the energy and nutrients you need to allow your body to grow and develop properly.
ex.t: 有了良好的饮食习惯，您将能够获得让身体正常生长和发育所需的能量和营养。

defs.def: to accept or admit sth; to agree that sth is true or correct 接受；承认；同意（某事属实或正确）

ex.s: These two pieces of information - the time of day and the point where the sun is in the sky - allow the butterfly to determine the way to go.
ex.t: 这两个信息--一天中的时间和太阳在天空中的位置--让蝴蝶决定前进的方向。
